caveats: Attachments do not effect an avatar's mass, only certain Appearance settings. Avatar mass is reported to either be unexpectedly low (when measured using llGetMass ) or unexpectedly high (when measured using llGetMassMKS ). This is likely due to the weight being calculated based on a fixed value, with a modifier for height. The fixed value being used is incorrect, likely due to an incorrect density value being used.
